# GeoTIFF UTM Boundary

A GeoTIFF that straddles a UTM zone boundary. Exercises reprojection and mosaic logic where a single tile spans two coordinate zones.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Case ID | `geotiff_utm_boundary` |
| Category | raster |
| Format | GeoTIFF |
| CRS | `EPSG:32633` |
| Test tier | unit |
| Size class | small |
| Storage class | bundled |
| Redistributable | yes |
| Loader | `rasterio` |
| Status | validated |

## Use this case

```python
import pytest


@pytest.mark.geocase_case("geotiff_utm_boundary")
def test_geotiff_utm_boundary(geocase_case) -> None:
    data = geocase_case.load()
    assert data is not None
```

## What this case checks

Detect raster code that assumes the entire tile lives in a single UTM zone, causing distortion or misalignment at zone edges.

## Risk types covered

- `pixel_shift`
- [`reprojection_error`](../risk/reprojection-error.md)
- `zone_boundary_artifact`
